prompt:
Create an ORIGINAL transparent PNG game VFX source sheet as a targeted revision of two skills in the supplied Võ Lâm Hero Defense preview. Input image 1 defines the current authored pixel VFX rendering quality and green palette. Input image 2 defines fixed elevated orthographic gameplay perspective, baked golden paving and native sprite size; do not depict that floor or actors in the output. Exactly TWO rows and THREE columns on a wide 3:2 canvas. Six isolated sprite drawings centered in six equal square cells with large transparent margins. Real alpha outside drawings and in hollow portions. No words, grid, lines, floor, people, hands, glowing wash, noise or hardware. High-contrast selective dark green edges, crisp pixel clusters, emerald and bright yellow-green light.

TOP ROW — THREE PHASES OF THE SAME SINGLE HAND FLAME, as if it wraps around one small unseen closed hand. Each cel has ONE strong curved tongue rises from a tight open C-shaped emerald lick at the bottom third that cups around the invisible palm. The lower third wraps like flame licking around a wrist in 3/4 view. Bottom point stays stable and the deep green near-transparent inner pocket remains wide enough to let the hero hand show through. The flame is wider and more substantial around the hand and tapers to a sharp lime tip above. In col 1 the upper tongue curls slightly inward, in col 2 the tip rises and curls out, in col 3 a softer returning flicker, all same size and lower pocket location. A few tight flecks max. No paired flames in a single cell, no detached ring, no blue. Designed to read at 25×32 px in Phaser.

BOTTOM ROW — THREE PHASES OF THE SAME SINGLE CIRCULAR POISON SMOKE FIELD. Each frame shows ONE complete contiguous dark jade and moss smoke bank rising low from one perfectly round circle on the ground. The circle projects as a horizontal ellipse in the fixed elevated camera, around a 2.15 to 1 width:height footprint. Show the entire boundary as a subdued organic smoky rim, like lighter low fumes lapping up around the perimeter of the same pool. The interior is filled with one cohesive layered semi-transparent low-lying emerald poison fog with several overlapping curls, so the area reads as a filled disc and remains distinguishable from the empty poison aura ring. No geometric crisp circular stroke, no sigil, no uniform disk, no liquid puddle, no separated puffs outside the pool and no highlights that look like fire. Keep wide and low. Use a stable centered elliptical ground contact and identical width and shape in all cels while the smoke folds drift and change: left crest rises, center softly churns, right crest unrolls. The bottom extent of the perimeter stays at exactly the same height across all three frames. Strong dark leaf-green contrast for tan stone ground and jade internal detail. Output this complete 3×2 isolated sheet for Aseprite.
